item.title: Reports: FBI Probed Kash Patel, Susie Wiles; 10 Employees Fired
item.description: Reports say the FBI conducted surveillance involving now-Director Kash Patel and Chief of Staff Susie Wiles as part of an investigation during the Biden administration. According to Fox News, ten bureau employees have since been fired in connection with the matter.

item.title: Netflix Exits Bidding for Warner Bros. Discovery, Clearing Path for Paramount Skydance $111B Deal
item.description: Netflix has stepped away from the bidding for Warner Bros. Discovery, paving the way for Paramount Skydance to secure its $111 billion acquisition of the iconic Hollywood studio.

item.title: NASA’s SpaceX CRS-33 Dragon Undocks from ISS, Splashdown Set for Friday Off California
item.description: NASA’s SpaceX CRS-33 Dragon cargo spacecraft has undocked from the International Space Station and departed successfully, with splashdown expected off the coast of California Friday morning.

item.title: U.S., Congo Sign $1.2 Billion Health Partnership Amid Aid Overhaul
item.description: The United States and Congo signed a $1.2 billion health partnership Thursday, the two countries’ governments said in a joint statement.
